contentPattern.structure: tab label + card-grid panel per row; each panel is a responsive multi-up grid of image + title + description cards

suitableFor: category/listing pages that filter a card grid via tabs (e.g. adventures by activity)
any tabbed switcher whose panels contain repeating card grids
notSuitableFor: tabbed prose/detail content with paragraphs, images and bullet lists (use tabs-detail)
